prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: a single animation sprite sheet for a novice exercise guide. Exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, NINE equal SQUARE cells in row-major chronological order, 9 different successive poses of ONE FORWARD HALF REP, no return yet. Same fixed orthographic camera, framing, scale, lighting, floor, person proportions, clothing, face and surface textures across all nine cells. No gutters, gridlines, borders, labels, arrows or text. Each cell shows the whole person, whole apparatus if any, with generous room, no cut-off hands/feet. Reference image is ONLY identity/material/style reference, not pose or machine geometry: muscular adult man, realistically defined muscles, tan natural skin, short dark hair, black shorts and black trainers, matte charcoal grey apparatus, warm off-white studio background and soft fixed floor shadow. Polished realistic colored educational 3D-render illustration; NOT simple low-poly or cartoon. Joint rotations must change continuously across nine poses; all body segment lengths stay identical. Exactly two arms/hands, two legs/feet. Render each cell separately at identical local coordinates. Exercise: REVERSE PEC DECK, rear deltoid fly machine. Rebuild machine entirely. Camera centered almost directly BEHIND athlete, elevated 28 degrees looking slightly down so BOTH forearms and hands can be seen as they sweep back. Athlete faces AWAY from camera, straddling a horizontal seat, chest resting against a SMALL VERTICAL chest pad IN FRONT of sternum; chair and pad on same front-to-back centreline as machine. Athlete back toward camera is stationary, pelvis planted, feet down. Entire apparatus visible. Machine weight tower is an OPAQUE dark enclosure located FAR OUTSIDE the arm-sweep area at the far-right edge; a stationary overhead crossmember connects it to two pivot bearings in front of/above shoulder line. Exactly TWO thin rigid curved lever arms from the overhead pivot bearings down to exactly TWO vertical black handles, one gripped by each hand. Both levers have a free unobstructed sweep, no clipping the tower, body, chest pad or each other. Human elbows have a CONSTANT slight bend of 20degrees. BOTH arms and BOTH handles MUST MOVE SIMULTANEOUSLY AND SYMMETRICALLY each cell, never one arm motionless. 9 equal increments of shoulder horizontal abduction: start arms forward with 20degrees outward abduction (hands separated, no crossing); progress to30,40,50,60,70,80,90,100degree outward from straight ahead to broadly open at shoulderheight. At final both arms create a wide T relative to torso. The left and right hand trajectories mirror each other across the body's vertical centreline in every cell; both hands visibly travel laterally outward with each subsequent cell. No one-sided animation. Lever count two throughout, hand count two throughout, fingers gripping handles, elbows never flare into U. Fixed torso, head, chest pad, seat, pivot locations and tower.

Offwhite background, soft lighting, black shorts/trainers, grey equipment. Fixed camera/floor/torso/head/feet/pelvis and all lengths across all cells. Smooth incremental pose changes, rigid objects, no extra limbs. CRITICAL anatomical guide is physically constructed in 3D with a fixed bend, so do not straighten the elbows or reinterpret them as curls. Anatomically detailed real muscles, no cylinders/simple polygon mannequin. Reverse pec deck. This guide shows rear-centered 28degree-elevated camera, man faces AWAY with chest on fixed centerline chestpad and seat straddled. Keep both human arms in SAME guided positions mirror-symmetrically each frame. Both sweep horizontally back/out SIMULTANEOUSLY, actual elbow20degreeflexion remains CONSTANT, not extending elbows. The start's apparent U due elevated rear perspective is OUT-OF-PLANE FORESHORTENING, NOT 90degree elbow bend; upperarms point forward-away from camera. Exact shoulder/elbow/wrist positions in guide are authoritative. Final arms open in wide T with same20degreebend. Exactly2hands,2handles,2thin overhead rigid curved levers. Their overhead pivot locations FIXED above shoulderjoints; rods rotate around verticalaxis with constant length and drop vertically to hands. Covered tower sits FAR RIGHT OUTSIDE sweptarea: tower guide at localx370..409, while farthesthandx330. No overlapping or intersecting tower/lever. Machine overhead beam stays behind leverarc with airgap. Chestpad small infrontsternum, seat aligned with machinecenterline. Man/chair faces front of machine, not sideways. Draw adequate side margins, nothingcutoff.
